# rlsbl targets

List every release target rlsbl supports (go, npm, pypi) with the files its version lives in, and whether the member whose directory holds the working directory has it: the targets the member declares in .strictmetadata/releasables/releasables.toml, or, when it declares none, the ones its manifests are detected as.

**Effect:** read_only
